subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Segmentar corretamente as palavras ao escrever frases e textos.

components.description_pt: Identificar limites corretos de palavras ao escrever sentenças
components.description_en: Identify correct word boundaries when writing sentences
components.cc_component_description: Capitalize the first word in a sentence and the pronoun I when writing

components.description_pt: Segmentar corretamente palavras em um texto contínuo
components.description_en: Correctly segment words from one another when writing a continuous text
components.cc_component_description: Apply position-based spelling rules when writing words in context

components.description_pt: Reconhecer e corrigir erros de hipersegmentação e hiposegmentação
components.description_en: Recognize and correct hypersegmentation and hyposegmentation errors in written sentences
components.cc_component_description: Identify and correct misspellings of studied words in written sentences

cc_matches.description: Use spelling patterns and generalizations (e.g., word families, position-based spellings, syllable patterns, ending rules, meaningful word parts) in writing words.
Use conventional spelling for high-frequency and other studied words and for adding suffixes to base words (e.g., sitting, smiled, cries, happiness).
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
